status: PROPOSED for H1 (2026-10-21 UTC, revised after the maintainer's H1 decision): the corpus H1's arm B is cut from. Built by scripts/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/build_master_ladder.py once its sessions exist; nothing is generated by this file.
size_measure: unique supervised assistant tokens (aadistill.data.dataset.final_assistant_loss_mask: <think>, reasoning, </think>, answer, <|im_end|>)
_shares: Reasoning 0.70 / supporting 0.30 of UNIQUE SUPERVISED POSITIONS: the maintainer's H1 starting point (2026-10-21), NOT a claimed optimum and not a factor under study (no ratio search). Shares are by supervised tokens, so long math traces cannot swallow the other axes. Instruction following is exercised by every task's explicit answer or action protocol and measured as answer-submission compliance; no dedicated instruction stratum (recorded risk). Tool calling is omitted (sources.json :: tool_calling).

primary.interactive_adaptation.unit: a whole episode, turn-expanded; the EPISODE is the independent unit

supporting.math_reused_gsm8k.reuse: corpus_v2's selected gsm8k targets whose final number matches the human gold (1,508 sessions); no new generation

supporting.code_algorithmic.verifier: aadistill.data.code_exec (execution against the dataset's tests inside the probed bubblewrap sandbox on the dev box, never on the generation pod: code_sandbox.py)

supporting.reading_verified.reuse: existing teacher targets whose selected answer is span-verified; no new generation

supporting.answerability.verifier: an explicit abstention stating the context does not contain the answer; NO word-count rule (the core verify.py refusal length limit is not used, AGENTS.md P3)

family_key: generator_id/family_id for procedural items; source id for external items
_reserve: the in-training validation tail (>= 16 blocks for aadistill.data.ladder.ladder_blocks), composition-matched and outside every rung

primary.records: answer with its scope; text_consistency (observation: textual agreement only); steps (not_assessed unless a step checker exists); action_legality (observation, episodes) -- generation_adapter.py

supporting.records: math: answer + text consistency; code: declared tests passed (code_exec, sandboxed), steps not_assessed; reading and answerability: answer only

acceptance.selection: lowest accepted candidate index; never by length
acceptance.length_rule: a session whose render exceeds block_len is EXCLUDED and counted, never cut (P17); the generation allowance is block_len - rendered prompt - 8 so a trace that cannot be trained is stopped as length_limited instead of paid for to 16k
acceptance.admission: whole units only: an episode any of whose sessions fails or does not fit is excluded entirely (build_master_ladder.render_all)

supporting.math_new._proxy: MATH train has no teacher record yet; corpus_v2's openmath (MATH-style, augmented, noisy key) is the pessimistic proxy

supporting.code_algorithmic._assumption: corpus_v2 code had no verifier (accepted_share unmeasurable); 0.4 = hygiene acceptance 0.854 x an assumed 0.5 test pass rate. A PLANNING ASSUMPTION, replaced by the run's own figure

supporting.answerability._proxy: same source and template, answerable questions

candidate_policy: up to 2 candidates per task, the second only when the first is rejected; every candidate recorded. Yield is planned at the measured n = 1 rate per generated token, which a retry does not change.
_yield: accepted supervised tokens per generated token, measured per stratum from Stage-0 teacher_cal (<= 8,192 rendered, verified) and corpus_v2 (verified under the contract); replaced by the generation run's own figure
_new_arm_rendered_per_supervised: share-weighted rendered/supervised from the dry run (fluid traces 1.055) and the audit's selected corpus_v2 sessions (gsm8k 1.068, openmath 1.025, rag 1.396, multihop 2.371); a planning figure

durability._network_volume_price: the recorded basis of the retired volumes (runs/netvol_20261019_051206/closeout/outcome.json)
durability._h1_backend_gb: peak H1 occupancy is about 18 GiB (4 fp32 student directories 8.9 GiB, one in-flight resume state ~7.2 GiB, the initialization 1.1 GiB, packs and generation records < 0.5 GiB); 30 GB leaves room for a failed-unit rerun (plans/durability_plan.json)

_rung_targets: H1 needs only 2.96M; 0.86M and 1.60M are its prefixes for free. A later 5.50M rung is D_2.96M plus a separately ordered increment of NEW units (ladder_plan.json :: extension), so H1's arm B stays a nested member of any later ladder without generating it now.
_reuse_first: existing teacher targets are reused where they pass the contract (verified-correct reading, multihop and gsm8k); A and B may then share sessions, which is recorded, and A itself is NOT cleaned (its definition is unchanged)
_source_allocation: PROPOSED split of each stratum's share by source, as sub-strata '<stratum>/<source>' the builder interleaves exactly like strata; induction and interactive have no external source that survives isolation, so they stay on the project generators. Used by the variant stage2.reasoning_master@v1 only; without approved third-party generators the corpus is the explicit variant stage2.reasoning_master@v1-project-only (variants), never this id with a quiet substitution.

stage2.reasoning_master@v1.what: the proposed scheme: the top-level source_allocation, third-party generators included

stage2.reasoning_master@v1-project-only.what: the same strata and shares with NO third-party generator: each primary stratum entirely from s0_generators_v2_calsplit, each supporting third-party share moved to that stratum's largest remaining source. A DIFFERENT corpus with its own id, chosen explicitly -- never a silent fallback of the first

_variants: source_plan.py turns a variant into per-(stratum, source) targets and refuses to emit a generation plan with an unapproved source; an unapproved source never falls back silently inside the same corpus id. The _source_allocation note's earlier fallback rule is superseded by the explicit project-only variant.
